requirement.original: Create right sidebar content renderers: Agent/Task conversation, File modification (Edit/Write/MultiEdit), Terminal/Bash output, and Generic tool content
requirement.clarified: Build four sidebar content renderer components that display tool-specific content when a user clicks a tool call in the main conversation. Reuse existing rendering components (TaskViewFull, EditViewFull, BashViewFull, ToolFullView) adapted for sidebar display.
requirement.what: Four sidebar content renderers + a dispatcher component
requirement.why: The right sidebar needs to show detailed tool content without full-screen navigation, providing a split-pane experience on desktop/tablet

excluded: Inline editing or command execution from sidebar
Full file content fetching (only changed portions available)

success_criteria: Agent/Task tool click renders full sub-conversation with MarkdownView and nested ToolView
Edit tool click renders unified diff with line numbers and +/- symbols
Write tool click renders all-green additions diff
MultiEdit tool click renders sequential edit hunks with edit numbers
Bash tool click renders command + stdout/stderr output
Unknown tools render generic input/output view
Dispatcher correctly routes tool names to renderers
All renderers handle running/completed/error tool states
constraints: Must reuse existing rendering components, not duplicate logic
Must use react-native-unistyles StyleSheet.create for styling
Must use t() for all user-visible strings
Must follow existing patterns: React.memo, 4-space indent
Must handle deeply nested Agent sub-conversations

context.codebase_state: Main branch, existing tool view components well-established

rendering_pipeline.summary: MessageView dispatches by message.kind. ToolCallMessage -> ToolView (inline) with click -> router.push to /session/{id}/message/{messageId} -> ToolFullView (full). The sidebar replaces the router.push navigation with inline sidebar rendering.
rendering_pipeline.message_view: sources/components/MessageView.tsx - dispatches user-text, agent-text, tool-call, agent-event
rendering_pipeline.tool_view: sources/components/tools/ToolView.tsx - inline tool card with header + content, uses getToolViewComponent() registry
rendering_pipeline.tool_full_view: sources/components/tools/ToolFullView.tsx - expanded view with description, input, specialized view, output, error sections in ScrollView
rendering_pipeline.chat_list: sources/components/ChatList.tsx - FlatList rendering MessageView for each message

task_view_full.key_pattern: ChildMessageList renders Message[] -> ChildMessageBlock dispatches agent-text to MarkdownView, tool-call to ToolView. Toggle expand/collapse. Uses useFilteredTools from TaskView.
task_view_full.reuse_strategy: Extract ChildMessageList/ChildMessageBlock logic, remove toggle (always expanded in sidebar)

edit_view_full.key_pattern: Parses knownTools.Edit.input (old_string, new_string), passes to ToolDiffView with showLineNumbers=true, showPlusMinusSymbols=true
edit_view_full.reuse_strategy: Reuse ToolDiffView directly with same parsing logic

write_view.key_pattern: Parses knownTools.Write.input (content), renders ToolDiffView with oldText='', newText=content
write_view.reuse_strategy: Same pattern as Edit but with empty old_string

multi_edit_view_full.key_pattern: Parses knownTools.MultiEdit.input (edits array), renders DiffView for each edit with edit number headers and separators
multi_edit_view_full.reuse_strategy: Reuse entire component or extract edit rendering logic

bash_view_full.key_pattern: Parses knownTools.Bash.result (stdout, stderr), renders CommandView in ScrollView with horizontal scroll
bash_view_full.reuse_strategy: Reuse CommandView with same parsing logic

tool_diff_view.key_pattern: Wraps DiffView with optional horizontal ScrollView based on wrapLines setting
tool_diff_view.reuse_strategy: Use directly for Edit/Write sidebar content

diff_view.key_pattern: Calculates unified diff with inline highlighting, renders hunks with line numbers, +/- symbols, leading space dots

tool_registry.inline_views: toolViewRegistry: Edit, Bash, CodexBash, CodexPatch, CodexDiff, Write, TodoWrite, ExitPlanMode, MultiEdit, Task, Agent, AskUserQuestion, edit, execute
tool_registry.full_views: toolFullViewRegistry: Bash, CodexBash, MultiEdit, Task, Agent

types.tool_call: { name, state, input, result, createdAt, startedAt, completedAt, description, permission }
types.tool_view_props: { tool: ToolCall, metadata: Metadata | null, messages: Message[], sessionId?: string }
types.tool_call_message: { kind: 'tool-call', id, localId, createdAt, tool: ToolCall, children: Message[] }

development_approach.strategy: Create new sidebar renderer components that compose existing rendering primitives (ToolDiffView, CommandView, MarkdownView, ToolView). Each renderer follows the same pattern as the existing FullView components but adapted for sidebar context (no navigation, always expanded, consistent props interface).
development_approach.validation_approach: Build dev web image, navigate to a session with Agent/Edit/Bash tools, click each tool type, verify sidebar renders correct content. Test on desktop viewport.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward component composition reusing existing well-established rendering patterns in the codebase
